The company benefits from its large scale, generating nearly $24.5 billion in revenue and solid profitability with an 11% operating margin and over $1.7 billion in net income. However, its highly leveraged capital structure—with total liabilities representing nearly 78% of total assets—and modest current ratio of 1.22 constrain the rating to the lower-to-mid investment-grade tier.

DECISION: BBB
